en: Lamentations 5

p.src: 1  Remember, LORD, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.

en: Remember, LORD, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.
u.src: 1  Remember, LORD, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.

p.src: 2  Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.

en: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.
u.src: 2  Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.

p.src: 3  We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.

en: We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.
u.src: 3  We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.

p.src: 4  We must pay for water to drink. Our wood is sold to us.

en: We must pay for water to drink. Our wood is sold to us.
u.src: 4  We must pay for water to drink. Our wood is sold to us.

p.src: 5  Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.

en: Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.
u.src: 5  Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.

p.src: 6  We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

en: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
u.src: 6  We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

p.src: 7  Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.

en: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.
u.src: 7  Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.

p.src: 8  Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.

en: Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.
u.src: 8  Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.

p.src: 9  We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the wilderness.

en: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the wilderness.
u.src: 9  We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the wilderness.

p.src: 10  Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.

en: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.
u.src: 10  Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.

p.src: 11  They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.

en: They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.
u.src: 11  They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.

p.src: 12  Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.

en: Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.
u.src: 12  Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.

p.src: 13  The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.

en: The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.
u.src: 13  The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.

p.src: 14  The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.

en: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.
u.src: 14  The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.

p.src: 15  The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.

en: The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.
u.src: 15  The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.

p.src: 16  The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!

en: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
u.src: 16  The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!

p.src: 17  For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim:

en: For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim:
u.src: 17  For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim:

p.src: 18  for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.

en: for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.
u.src: 18  for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.

p.src: 19  You, LORD, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.

en: You, LORD, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.
u.src: 19  You, LORD, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.

p.src: 20  Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time?

en: Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time?
u.src: 20  Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time?

p.src: 21  Turn us to yourself, LORD, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.

en: Turn us to yourself, LORD, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.
u.src: 21  Turn us to yourself, LORD, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.

p.src: 22  But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us.

en: But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us.
u.src: 22  But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us.
